title: Freelance Trainer
description:
**Company Description**
Skill-Lync is a technology-driven education company focused on helping learners build the technical skillsets needed to launch and grow their careers. The organization partners with industry experts to create high-quality, practical educational content that reflects current market needs. This content is delivered globally through Skill-Lync’s online platform, making advanced technical training accessible and affordable. The company is committed to supporting learners in developing job-ready capabilities and staying competitive in fast-evolving fields such as automotive engineering and artificial intelligence.

**Role Description**
This part-time, on-site Gen AI Automotive Engineer role is based in New Delhi. The individual in this role will develop and refine AI-driven models and tools applicable to automotive engineering workflows, such as design optimization, performance analysis, and predictive maintenance. Day-to-day tasks include collaborating with subject matter experts to translate automotive engineering problems into AI solutions, preparing technical content or demonstrations for learners, validating model outputs against real-world engineering scenarios, and documenting methodologies and best practices. The role may also involve supporting curriculum teams with up-to-date insights on AI applications in automotive systems, contributing to lab exercises, and providing occasional guidance or feedback to learners and internal teams.

**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in automotive engineering, including vehicle dynamics, powertrain systems, and automotive design principles.
* Applied experience with artificial intelligence or machine learning techniques relevant to engineering, such as data modeling, algorithm development, and model evaluation.
* Proficiency in programming languages commonly used in AI and engineering (e.g., Python, MATLAB) and familiarity with relevant libraries or tools (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Simulink).
* Ability to interpret complex technical data, run simulations, and translate engineering and AI concepts into clear, structured explanations for educational purposes.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in automotive engineering, mechanical engineering, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work collaboratively on-site in New Delhi.
* Prior experience in technical training, teaching, or content creation for engineering or AI domains is an advantage.

title: Applied AI Architect
description:
**Job Description**
About the Team
  
  
The AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries and digital-native businesses to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an AI Architect, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. You will act as the “CTO of your book of business”, shaping each customer's AI strategy and guiding their journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact.
  
  
You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate business priorities into a focused use-case portfolio, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable customer value and growth. The Account Director owns commercial strategy; you own the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value.
  
  
You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, and partners to provide deeper expertise and execute work where needed. This role calls for strong industry fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy and hands-on technical conversations.
  
  
This role can be based in Delhi, Mumbai, or Bangalore. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees
  
  
In this role, you will
  
  

* Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of existing customers and pre-sales prospects.
* Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, and expansion opportunities.
* Lead discovery with executives and technical teams to identify, qualify, and prioritize use cases tied to meaningful business outcomes.
* Develop clear Applied AI Architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment.
* Guide customers through technical evaluations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, and proofs of value, securing confidence in both the solution and its path to production.
* Maintain a focused use-case portfolio with clear decision criteria, ownership, blockers, success measures, delivery needs, and adoption plans.
* Develop trusted relationships and technical champions across CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, AI leaders, engineering teams, and other customer stakeholders.
* Qualify and coordinate support from Deployment Engineering, implementation, training and enablement, product and domain specialists, partners, and other delivery teams.
* Remain accountable for technical progress and customer outcomes while ensuring delivery teams own implementation execution once engaged.
* Track adoption, usage, account health, production readiness, and measurable customer impact, intervening early when risks threaten value realization.
* Apply industry or digital-native expertise to recognize repeatable patterns, sharpen customer priorities, and identify relevant expansion opportunities.
* Share customer insights with Product, Engineering, and Research, translating field learnings into better products, architecture guidance, and reusable practices.

You might thrive in this role if you
  
  

* Have significant experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical customer success.
* Have guided enterprise organizations from technical evaluation through production adoption and measurable business impact.
* Build credibility with senior technical and business leaders while communicating equally well with hands-on engineers.
* Bring strong software and cloud architecture foundations, including APIs, distributed systems, data integration, identity, security, and privacy.
* Understand modern AI systems, frontier LLM models, agentic applications, model evaluation, retrieval, or enterprise AI workflows.
* Can prototype, explain technical tradeoffs, and work confidently with APIs, SDKs, and languages such as Python or JavaScript.
* Exercise sound judgment about when to go deep personally, when to involve specialists, and how to define clear handoffs and ownership.
* Have experience developing technical account plans, prioritizing complex customer portfolios, and connecting adoption to measurable outcomes.
* Bring meaningful expertise in a relevant industry or strong fluency with the needs of digital-native businesses.
* Communicate clearly and can turn ambiguity into a practical technical narrative, executive decision, or action plan.
* Work collaboratively across disciplines and care deeply about helping organizations deploy advanced AI responsibly.

**About OpenAI**
OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.
  
  
For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.
  
  
Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.
  
  
To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.
  
  
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link.
  
  
OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy
  
  
At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

title: Quantitative Researcher
description:
**Job Description**

**Job Title:**
Quantitative Researcher

**Location:**
New Delhi, India

**Type:**
Full-time | September 2025

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Quantitative Researcher to join our small, high-impact team. As the second Quantitative Researcher on our team of four, you will play a critical role in researching alphas, devising and back testing new trading strategies, and optimizing execution efficiencies. You will work closely with the quant team and developers to convert research insights into actionable, profitable strategies.

**Key Responsibilities**

·     
**Alpha Research:**
Conduct in-depth research to discover new alphas, focusing on market inefficiencies and signals that can be exploited systematically.

·     
**Strategy Development:**
Design, back test, and optimize trading strategies using quantitative techniques to maximize performance and minimize risk.

·     
**Execution Strategy**
: Develop efficient execution methodologies that align with the firm’s strategies, leveraging low-latency infrastructure where necessary.

·     
**Data Analysis**
: Work with large datasets, develop insights, and use statistical methods to improve existing strategies or develop new ones.

·     
**Model Validation**
: Ensure robust validation of models and strategies, including stress testing and risk assessment.

·     
**Collaborative Integration**
: Collaborate with software engineers to seamlessly integrate research models into the trading infrastructure.

·     
**Performance Evaluation**
: Continuously monitor and evaluate strategy performance, making adjustments as needed to enhance profitability.

·     
**Industry Research**
: Stay updated on the latest academic research and market trends to keep strategies competitive.

**Qualifications**

·     Advanced degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Financial Engineering).

·     Strong proficiency in Python; familiarity with C++ is advantageous.

·     Experience in quantitative research, alpha generation, and systematic trading strategy development.

·     Proficiency in statistical analysis, machine learning, and data science techniques.

·     Ability to work with large datasets and develop data pipelines.

·     Collaborative mindset, with strong communication skills for working closely with software developers and traders.

**What We Offer**

·     
**Growth Potential**
: Join at an early stage and grow with the firm, playing a key role in shaping our quant trading capabilities.

·     
**Ownership & Profit Sharing:**
Opportunity for equity and profit sharing as part of a growing, high-impact team.

·     
**Innovative Environment:**
Work in a dynamic, innovation-driven environment where new ideas are highly valued.

·     
**Collaborative Culture:**
Collaborate with top professionals in finance, technology, and quantitative research.

Please feel free to reach out!

title: Associate AI/ML Enngineer
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
**Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and deploy scalable AI/ML solutions across healthcare domain
* Select, implement, and optimize supervised and unsupervised learning algorithms for classification, regression, clustering, anomaly detection, and forecasting
* Learn and adopt AIDLC as the standard development approach, and promote its adoption through training and knowledge sharing
* Develop deep learning, NLP, computer vision, recommender-system, reinforcement-learning, and generative AI models based on business needs
* Perform feature engineering, hyperparameter tuning, cross-validation, error analysis, and model comparison using appropriate evaluation metrics
* Build retrieval-augmented generation and Agentic AI solutions with planning, reasoning, memory, tool use, and multi-agent orchestration
* Integrate models and AI agents with enterprise APIs, applications, data sources, vector databases, and workflow platforms
* Implement human-in-the-loop controls, guardrails, access controls, and escalation paths for high-impact AI workflows
* Develop reliable data ingestion, training, inference, and model-output pipelines
* Evaluate models and agents for predictive performance, bias, retrieval quality, hallucination, safety, latency, reliability, and cost
* Design and maintain CI/CD and LLMOps/MLOps pipelines, including automated testing, versioning, deployment, monitoring, and rollback
* Develop secure, scalable services using Python, FastAPI, REST APIs, containers, and cloud or Kubernetes platforms
* Communicate AI/ML approaches, algorithm choices, trade-offs, risks, and results clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications**

* Graduate degree or equivalent experience
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field
* 4+ years of experience in software engineering, data science, analytics, or related fields, including 2+ years of hands-on AI/ML engineering experience
* Experience with deep learning architectures such as feed-forward networks, CNNs, RNNs/LSTMs, attention mechanisms, and Transformers
* Experience applying algorithms to NLP, computer vision, recommender systems, reinforcement learning, and generative AI use cases
* Experience developing and deploying NLP, large language model, retrieval-augmented generation, and generative AI solutions
* Hands-on experience designing Agentic AI solutions using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or CrewAI
* Experience building agent workflows with planning, reasoning, tool and function calling, task delegation, memory, context management, and human-in-the-loop controls
* Experience with LLMOps/MLOps practices, including experiment tracking, dataset, prompt, and model versioning, automated testing, monitoring, deployment, and rollback
* Experience developing production services with FastAPI, Flask, REST APIs, Streamlit, Docker, and Kubernetes
* Experience deploying data pipelines, models, or AI applications on Azure, AWS, or GCP; Azure, Azure Machine Learning, and Databricks experience is preferred
* Solid understanding of supervised and unsupervised learning algorithms, including linear and logistic regression, decision trees, random forests, gradient boosting, support vector machines, nearest-neighbor methods, clustering, dimensionality reduction, anomaly detection, and time-series forecasting
* Knowledge of feature engineering, sampling, regularization, hyperparameter optimization, cross-validation, class-imbalance handling, explainability, and model-selection techniques
* Ability to select and interpret evaluation metrics such as precision, recall, F1 score, ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, log loss, RMSE, MAE, ranking metrics, and business-specific measures
* Solid proficiency in Python and PySpark, with hands-on experience using Scikit-learn, TensorFlow or PyTorch, Pandas, NumPy, and MLflow
* Familiarity with open-source and commercial LLMs, Hugging Face, model APIs, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, and retrieval architectures
* Ability to evaluate and secure AI systems using observability, guardrails, responsible AI practices, hallucination mitigation, retrieval-quality assessment, and performance and cost optimization
* Proven excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, including root-cause analysis, algorithmic trade-off assessment, and practical solution design

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. title: Analyst, TSG Product Management
description:
**COMPANY PROFILE**

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.

Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefining industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.

  

The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.

  

**WHAT MAKES US GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work. We are currently the #1 ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor's Best Places to Work list and have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list since its founding in 2009.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don't happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

**Job Summary**

The Analyst, TSG Product Management, is assigned to one or a few products. The Analyst is responsible for responding to user inquiries and troubleshooting issues, performing routine updates, and validating changes through testing. This role gathers product insights by tracking key metrics, monitoring usage and adoption, and collecting user feedback through periodic surveys. The Analyst also scopes and drives smaller enhancement requests — translating business needs into clear requirements — while communicating effectively with business users, technical teams, and other stakeholders to ensure their needs are fulfilled.

  

**Principal Accountabilities and % of time**

**Product Maintenance & Analytics (50%)**

* Supports existing enterprise analytics products (e.g., Power BI and Tableau) by responding to user inquiries and troubleshooting issues, investigating root cause and escalating to technical teams or platform specialists when required
* Independently makes complex manual updates based on incoming requests, applying sound judgment to optimize the product
* Runs periodic user surveys and forums to track satisfaction and identify areas for improvement
* Tracks and analyzes key metrics — including dashboards, usage, and adoption — summarizing insights and findings for stakeholders
* Tests routine updates and enhancements to validate functionality and ensure a user-friendly experience

**Manage Enhancement Requests (40%)**

* Elicits requirements on small-to-medium sized requests, working with users to translate use cases and pain points into underlying requirements and potential solutions
* Transforms these requests into actionable work via user stories, process flow diagrams, and other supporting documentation
* Works with appropriate technical teams and third parties to complete these items, prioritizing and communicating dependencies and tradeoffs with key stakeholders throughout

**Develop Domain Knowledge (10%)**

* Builds domain knowledge and a comprehensive understanding of relevant tools and platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Databricks or similar enterprise data platforms) to act more independently
* Stays up to date about emerging analytics technologies, including AI tools, to continuously improve ways of working

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to synthesize data, user feedback, and operational metrics into clear insights and recommended actions, and exhibit root-cause thinking
* Strong user support and troubleshooting skills; ability to respond to user inquiries, investigate issues, identify root causes, resolve where appropriate, and escalate effectively to technical teams or platform specialists
* Working knowledge of business intelligence and analytics concepts (e.g., dashboards/reporting, data access, user permissions, tool platform concepts, adoption, and common end-user workflows); familiarity with tools such as Power BI or Tableau; experience consuming data from Databricks or an enterprise data platform preferred

title: Senior Associate - Deals Advisory - Deals Strategy
description:
**Job Description**
Job Overview:
  
  
This position is for a Senior Associate to be part of a fast-growing Strategy& practice within our Advisory Acceleration Centre.
  
  
Strategy& (S&) is our global strategy consulting business. It is a specialist team within PwC that combines strategy consulting capabilities with leading industry and sector insights and know-how. The team helps clients identify and build the capabilities essential to their advantage, and develop strategies based on these capabilities.
  
  
S& serves four main go-to-market channels: Deal Execution (M&A), Post-Deal Value Creation, Portfolio Companies, Corporate and Public Sector Clients (non-deals) across industries (including Technology, Media, Telco, Consumer Products, Retail, Industrials, Professional Services, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, Pharma).
  
  
The Deals channel is the largest channel for our UK team. Our work shapes the M&A landscape by supporting private equity (PE) and corporate clients in developing investment perspectives and value creation strategies that make a difference in the highly competitive M&A market.
  
  
We serve PE clients with over £2.5 trillion in assets under management, and publicly traded companies with a combined market capitalisation of over £4 trillion. From initial investment strategy development to commercial due diligence, value creation post-close and exit, we’re here to help our clients drive growth.
  
  
The S& Acceleration Centre in India is a specialist team within our broader PwC Kolkata Acceleration Centre that plays a critical role working with the UK team in project preparation and executing, including all responsibilities typically required of a UK-based team member from Experienced Associate to Manager. This includes analysis, research, output creation, presentation and discussion.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include**

* Help create and review delivery modules such as market analysis (sizing, forecasting, etc.), competitive analysis (benchmarking, differentiation, landscape analysis), business plan analysis, customer and financial analysis, survey analysis, website scraping, industry research, and more
* Conduct rigorous analysis in Microsoft Excel, and produce client-ready output in Microsoft PowerPoint
* Drive day-to-day deliverables within the Project team by helping in work-planning, problem solving, hypotheses generation and research tools, including reviewing your work and that of others for quality, accuracy, and relevance
* Work closely with the UK S& team to fully support client engagements
* Assist with KAC team onboarding and training programmes
* Contribute to the development of your own and team’s technical and functional acumen
* Demonstrate critical thinking, an ability to bring order to unstructured problems, and excellent commercial acumen
* Delegate to others to provide stretch opportunities, coaching them to deliver results
* Uphold the firm's code of ethics and business conduct

**Other Areas**

* Contribute to practice enablement and business development activities (proposal responses, client interactions, workshop preparation, etc.)
* Learning new tools and technologies including generative AI (genAI) as required
* Develop/implement automation solutions and capabilities that are aligned to clients’ business requirements
* Know how and when to use tools available for a given situation and explain reasons for this choice
* Develop internal relationships to build trust in an effort to develop and market the KAC brand
* Keep up to date with local and global business and economic issues
* Use feedback and reflection to develop self-awareness, personal strengths and address development areas
* Use straightforward communication, in a structured way, when influencing and connecting with others
* Provide others with examples of prior problem solving to help guide team members
* Staying in the loop and on top of the latest M&A trends

**Desired Experience And Skills**

* 4 to 7 years of industry experience with an emphasis on consulting services and project delivery
* Relevant experience in private equity, commercial due diligence, target screening and / or M&A advisory is an asset
* Ability to understand, contextualise, and solve commercial problems through independent analysis and research
* Ability to work as an integrated team member with the UK team in delivering client work, and to effectively take ownership and work on projects under stringent timelines while working both independently and in a team environment
* Effective written and excellent verbal business communication skills when interacting with team members and/or clients in a professional setting
* Ability to utilise project management skills to time-manage tasks
* Experience in creating clear and concise reports, including graphics and data visualisation and commentary for clients, and clearly presenting findings to others
* Relevant experience in conducting primary research (including desktop research, surveys and web scraping) and secondary research required
* Relevant experience in analysis of complex data (e.g. survey outputs, financial statements, business plans) required
* Relevant experience in creating client-ready deliverables including PowerPoint slides and reports required
* Experience in using Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint is required, and experience with data visualisation tools like Power BI and other similar tools is an asset
* Multi-tasking and balancing time effectively, keeping a rapid pace without sacrificing quality

**Desired Soft Skills**

* Strong work ethic, proactive and professional behaviour
* Strategic and creative thinker, problem solver

**Educational Background**

* MBA from premier B-Schools (preferred)
* Strong academic credentials, analytical ability and leadership skills

**Additional Information**

* Time type: Full time
* Work timings: Work hours may vary for specific projects
* Travel requirements: None
* Past experience: Past experience in consulting and exposure to a multinational environment will be an added bonus.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
**Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Demonstrated experience working with PBM / pharmacy data ecosystems
* Serve as SME for PBM data analytics, using advanced SQL to answer complex questions
* Translate analysis into business-ready narratives-clear insights, quantified impacts, and practical recommendations
* Work with large datasets received from multiple sources and housed in data warehouses ensure data is usable for reporting and analytical purposes
* Partner with stakeholders to provide training/UAT support to business users on analytic outputs and definitions to increase adoption and reduce rework
* Collaborate with Engineering/IT to design and implement right workflows, ensuring data extracts are migrated efficiently and securely
* Apply solid understanding of dimensional modeling and relational database concepts
* Act as an escalation point for complex analytic issues; provide timely updates to leadership and business partners
* Ensure adherence to governance standards for healthcare data, including privacy, access controls, and secure handling of sensitive datasets
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree (Business, Computer Science, or related field) or equivalent experience
* 5+ years of experience designing, developing, testing, implementing scalable BI/analytic solutions and working with relational databases
* Proven hands-on expertise in SQL for analytics and data manipulation; experience with large datasets in warehouse environments
* Experience building and maintaining dashboards in Power BI / Tableau and enabling self-service analytics
* Experience designing or partnering on ETL/ELT processes and maintaining documentation (data dictionaries, metric definitions, lineage)
* Experience applying data security/compliance best practices in healthcare/regulated environments
* Solid analytical/problem-solving skills; solid written and verbal communication skills; ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders
* Solid proficiency with SQL; ability to profile and validate large volumes of structured data
* Ability to coach/mentor junior analysts and act as a go-to resource for complex analytics
* Solid stakeholder management and ability to influence without authority
* Familiar with PBM Domain Data

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone - of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income - deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*
